system.description:
Usage applied to one corpse. Activate 1 minute.

The grey-white ash is traditionally collected from the cremation fires of people whose funerary rites were completed without dispute.

Scatter the ashes over a corpse while speaking the deceased's name, if known. For 24 hours, any magical effect attempting to possess the corpse, animate it as Undead or bind the deceased creature's soul to its remains must first successfully Counteract the ashes. Use item level 3 for the Counteract level.

The ashes do not prevent resurrection, reincarnation or communication with a willing dead creature.

On the sheet: used, the card records the 24-hour ward; a Counteract against it is rolled from the card at level 3.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
